headline: J Cole really started praying that the 9 year old fan would know his verse 😭😂🔥 Via: @ta
body:
J Cole really started praying that the 9 year old fan would know his verse 😭😂🔥
Via: @taylorayjohnson 

Johnny P’s Caddy” dropped January 28, 2022 , Cole’s birthday as the lead single from Benny the Butcher’s Tana Talk 4. Alchemist on the beat.

It debuted and peaked at #72 on the Hot 100, hit #22 on R&B/Hip-Hop and #14 on Rap Songs. First time Benny (and Griselda) ever charted on the Hot 100. Certified Gold by the RIAA in 2023, making it the label’s first gold plaque.

Over 129 million Spotify streams later and the song still moves. One of Cole’s cleanest features to date.
